physical_meaning: One world-axis rigid increment about measured EEF pivot applied to previous desired target; not a future measured pose
goal_update: p_new=c+d+R_delta*(p_previous_goal-c); R_new=R_delta*R_previous_goal, then explicit workspace clipping if specified
deployment_rule_candidate: Update desired goal once per source command; reuse fixed goal with measured native feedback between updates. Do not add the increment four times for one nominal5Hz command.
nonterminal_row_convention: Only first44 rows of the one45-row record; inherited conservative convention, no new terminal qualification
